link=[]

library=true
[dependencies]
gftl={git="https://github.com/Goddard-Fortran-Ecosystem/gFTL",rev="4af86210b6cc6ac46d3298b6861571aa26bd6acc"}
gftl-shared={git="https://github.com/Goddard-Fortran-Ecosystem/gFTL-shared",rev="8009755e846560fbb389c01d76e013ddf14a7f98"}
yafyaml={git="https://github.com/Goddard-Fortran-Ecosystem/yaFyaml",rev="d6005c9f635c02d7be54d09b205b6f16c54f46b5"}

scope: The serial pFlogger library uses pinned gFTL, selected gFTL-shared containers and yaFyaml. The checked consumer writes YAML configuration, logs four severity levels to a file, and verifies that only the two expected warning/error records were accepted. MPI logging is outside this build scope. Three additional upstream v2 map instantiations are supplied as a separate checksum-locked generated asset, leaving the existing vector asset unchanged. Root COPYRIGHT identifies Apache-2.0; the historical license PDFs are retained alongside it. R covers logging service routines.
initial_consumer_findings: FPM scans inactive MPI USE statements. The serial wrapper declares those lowercase module names external, while leaving _LOGGER_USE_MPI undefined and excluding MPI implementation sources. No MPI runtime is installed for this recipe.

The pFlogger-specific gFTL-shared asset adds three maps without modifying the already published vector-only asset. gFTL and gFTL-shared use generated-source fingerprinted shared exports; yaFyaml is compiled in this recipe because ungenerated repackaged sources remain ineligible for shared export.
generated_source_support: See ../../fpm-generated-sources.md. Separate audited map asset included in local exports; CMake and m4 are not run during visitor preparation.
